purpose: Live city parcel qualification with unmodified responses through the repository adapter; IDs and hashes retained, full geometries confined to temporary audit cache except three public samples.

descriptor.name: Geobasis NRW ALKIS parcels
descriptor.scope: North Rhine-Westphalia ALKIS cadastral map; bounded Essen, Cologne and Dortmund globe entries enabled. Other German states need separate sources. The named flstkennz identity is serialized as GeoJSON feature.id; objid and aktualit remain version metadata.
descriptor.attribution: Bezirksregierung Köln / Geobasis NRW, ALKIS simplified schema. Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.
